title: Observability: Grafana users (honest credential-drift report)
description: Runs `nexus acl observability list`. Reads the Grafana admin password from Vault KV and lists users via /api/admin/users. On the current tier the live Grafana admin password has drifted from KV (a v0.8.1-greenfield casualty), so the verb correctly returns HTTP 401 with the exact reconcile command — honest, actionable output rather than a false success.

observe.what: an actionable error: the live Grafana admin password has drifted from KV; reconcile via grafana-cli admin reset-admin-password <kv-value>

whatProves: ObservabilityAdapter.AclAsync lists Grafana users via /api/admin/users; on a credential-drifted tier it reports the 401 with the reconcile command instead of masking it. On a reconciled tier it lists users with the grafana-admin flag.
